+# Backend design constraints and follow-ups
 
-- **Schema + API contracts are backend-owned now**: See `backend/DB_SCHEMA_MVP` (target MVP) and `backend/DB_SCHEMA_FULL` (optional post-MVP notes). OpenAPI snapshots are generated from the running backend (`backend/generated/openapi.json`, mirrored at `backend/openapi_new.yaml`).

 from typing import Any
 
+from sqlalchemy import func
 from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
 
+from app.constants import ModerationStatusName
+from app.db.models import ModerationStatus
+from app.domain.lookups import get_seeded_id
+
+
+def ensure_catalog_alias(
+    db: Session,
+    *,
+    alias_model: type[Any],
+    alias_fk_attr: str,
+    catalog_id: str,
+    alias: str,
+    created_by_user_id: str | None,
+) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+    """Reuse a case-insensitive alias within a canonical row, or create it pending."""
+
+    existing = (
+        db.query(alias_model)
+        .filter(
+            getattr(alias_model, alias_fk_attr) == catalog_id,
+            func.lower(alias_model.alias) == alias.lower(),
+        )
+        .first()
+    )
+    if existing:
+        return existing, False
+
+    row = alias_model(
+        **{
+            alias_fk_attr: catalog_id,
+            "alias": alias,
+            "moderation_status_id": get_seeded_id(db, ModerationStatus, ModerationStatusName.pending.value),
+            "created_by_user_id": created_by_user_id,
+        }
+    )
+    db.add(row)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(row)
+    return row, True
+

+"""Catalog resolution contracts used by profile, preference, and job mutations."""
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+
+from app.constants import ModerationStatusName
+from app.db.models import ModerationStatus, RecordStatus, User
+from app.db.models.catalogs import (
+    Certification,
+    CertificationAlias,
+    Location,
+    LocationAlias,
+    Organization,
+    OrganizationAlias,
+    Position,
+    PositionAlias,
+    Skill,
+    SkillAlias,
+)
+from app.domain import catalog_utils
+from app.domain.catalogs import create_catalog_alias
+from app.db.models.users import AuditEvent
+from app.domain.lookups import get_seeded_id
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=[
+    (catalog_utils.get_or_create_organization, Organization, OrganizationAlias, "name", "organization_id"),
+    (catalog_utils.get_or_create_position, Position, PositionAlias, "title", "position_id"),
+    (catalog_utils.get_or_create_skill, Skill, SkillAlias, "name", "skill_id"),
+    (catalog_utils.get_or_create_location, Location, LocationAlias, "name", "location_id"),
+    (catalog_utils.get_or_create_certification, Certification, CertificationAlias, "name", "certification_id"),
+], ids=["organization", "position", "skill", "location", "certification"])
+def catalog_case(request):
+    return request.param
+
+
+def resolve(db, case, value):
+    resolver, _, _, field, _ = case
+    return resolver(db, **{field: value, "created_by_user_id": None})
+
+
+def test_creation_normalizes_text_and_reuses_case_insensitive_alias(db, catalog_case):
+    _, model, alias_model, field, foreign_key = catalog_case
+    row = resolve(db, catalog_case, "  Example\t Catalog  ")
+    assert getattr(row, field) == "Example Catalog"
+    same = resolve(db, catalog_case, "example catalog")
+    assert same.id == row.id
+    assert db.query(model).count() == 1
+    alias = db.query(alias_model).one()
+    assert str(getattr(alias, foreign_key)) == str(row.id)
+    assert alias.alias == "Example Catalog"
+    assert alias.created_by_user_id is None
+    assert str(alias.moderation_status_id) == get_seeded_id(db, ModerationStatus, "pending")
+
+
+def test_alias_resolution_follows_canonical_merges(db, catalog_case):
+    _, _, alias_model, _, foreign_key = catalog_case
+    old = resolve(db, catalog_case, "Old Catalog")
+    canonical = resolve(db, catalog_case, "Canonical Catalog")
+    old.merged_into_id = str(canonical.id)
+    db.add(alias_model(**{
+        foreign_key: str(old.id),
+        "alias": "Accepted Variant",
+        "moderation_status_id": get_seeded_id(db, ModerationStatus, "approved"),
+    }))
+    db.commit()
+
+    assert resolve(db, catalog_case, "accepted variant").id == canonical.id
+    assert resolve(db, catalog_case, "Old Catalog").id == canonical.id
+
+
+def test_rejected_alias_is_not_resolved_or_modified(db, catalog_case):
+    _, _, alias_model, _, foreign_key = catalog_case
+    canonical = resolve(db, catalog_case, "Existing Catalog")
+    rejected_status_id = get_seeded_id(db, ModerationStatus, ModerationStatusName.rejected.value)
+    rejected = alias_model(**{
+        foreign_key: str(canonical.id),
+        "alias": "Rejected Variant",
+        "moderation_status_id": rejected_status_id,
+    })
+    db.add(rejected)
+    db.commit()
+
+    replacement = resolve(db, catalog_case, "Rejected Variant")
+    assert replacement.id != canonical.id
+    assert str(rejected.moderation_status_id) == rejected_status_id
+    # Identical aliases can belong to different canonical rows.
+    assert db.query(alias_model).filter(alias_model.alias == "Rejected Variant").count() == 2
+
+
+def test_blank_input_does_not_create_catalog_rows(db, catalog_case):
+    _, model, alias_model, _, _ = catalog_case
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
+        resolve(db, catalog_case, " \t\n ")
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 400
+    assert db.query(model).count() == 0
+    assert db.query(alias_model).count() == 0
+
+
+def test_alias_creation_audits_only_new_aliases_and_preserves_author(db):
+    active = get_seeded_id(db, RecordStatus, "active")
+    author = User(email="alias-author@example.com", hashed_password="hashed", record_status_id=active)
+    other = User(email="alias-other@example.com", hashed_password="hashed", record_status_id=active)
+    db.add_all([author, other])
+    db.commit()
+    skill = catalog_utils.get_or_create_skill(db, name="Example Skill", created_by_user_id=None)
+    alias = create_catalog_alias(db, author, catalog_type="skills", catalog_id=str(skill.id), alias="Variant")
+    approved_status_id = get_seeded_id(db, ModerationStatus, "approved")
+    alias.moderation_status_id = approved_status_id
+    db.commit()
+    repeated = create_catalog_alias(db, other, catalog_type="skills", catalog_id=str(skill.id), alias="VARIANT")
+
+    assert repeated.id == alias.id
+    assert str(alias.created_by_user_id) == str(author.id)
+    assert str(alias.moderation_status_id) == approved_status_id
+    assert db.query(SkillAlias).count() == 2
+    event = db.query(AuditEvent).filter(AuditEvent.action == "catalog.skills.alias_created").one()
+    assert str(event.actor_user_id) == str(author.id)
+    assert event.context == {"alias": "Variant"}
+
+
+def test_location_metadata_is_normalized_and_name_only_lookup_reuses_existing(db):
+    paris = catalog_utils.get_or_create_location(
+        db, name=" Paris ", city=" Paris ", country=" France ", timezone=" Europe/Paris ",
+        created_by_user_id=None,
+    )
+    assert (paris.name, paris.city, paris.country, paris.timezone) == ("Paris", "Paris", "France", "Europe/Paris")
+    assert catalog_utils.get_or_create_location(db, name="paris", created_by_user_id=None).id == paris.id

-# Coopain OpenAPI
+# API documentation
 
-Manually maintained spec + lightweight Swagger UI server for local browsing/testing.
+Start the backend following `../backend/README.md`, then open:
 
-## Prerequisites
+- Swagger UI: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`
+- ReDoc: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc`
+- Live schema: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json`
 
-- Node.js 18+ (with `npm`)
+The backend serves the docs and API on the same origin, including Swagger's
+"Try it out" requests. For a remote backend, use its URL with the same paths.
+The standalone Node docs server and copied YAML schema have been retired.
 
-## Install
-
-```bash
-cd openapi
-npm install
-```
-
-## Run the docs
-
-- `npm start` → serves Swagger UI on `http://localhost:3000/api-docs`
-- `npm run dev` → same but with `nodemon` (reloads when `openapi.yaml` changes)
-- `COOPAIN_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 npm start` → override backend target if needed
-
-## How requests are routed (important)
-
-`server.js` intentionally overrides the spec `servers` at runtime and sends all
-Swagger "Try it out" calls through `http://localhost:3000/__backend_proxy/...`.
-
-Why:
-- avoids browser CORS failures between docs server and backend
-- avoids `localhost` DNS/IP version mismatches (`::1` vs `127.0.0.1`)
-- allows replacing `openapi.yaml` freely without breaking request execution
-
-Do not remove this runtime proxy override when updating the OpenAPI docs server.
-
-## Edit the spec
-
-1. Update `openapi/openapi.yaml` manually.
-2. Refresh Swagger UI (or restart the server if you’re not using `npm run dev`).
-
-You can also fetch the raw file at `http://localhost:3000/openapi.yaml`.
-
-## Optional validation
-
-Install Redocly CLI once:
-
-```bash
-npm install -g @redocly/openapi-cli
-```
-
-Run validation whenever needed:
-
-```bash
-openapi lint openapi.yaml
-```
-
-## Quick troubleshooting
-
-- If "Try it out" returns `TypeError: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource.`:
-  1. make sure backend is reachable (`curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health`)
-  2. restart this docs server (`npm start`) so latest `server.js` is loaded
-  3. if backend is not on `127.0.0.1:8000`, set `COOPAIN_API_BASE_URL`
+To export a schema for offline use, run `./refresh_doc.sh` from `backend/`.
+The exported contract is `backend/generated/openapi.json`.
